bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM emc_erp_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM emc_operations_event e JOIN emc_operations_event_definition d ON d.code = e.definition_code WHERE e.status = 'OPEN' AND d.oee_bucket = 'AVAILABILITY'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM emc_material_lot WHERE status = 'STOCK' AND quantity < 10
